summary.text: Dori Hauck is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 36 (Hebron) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dori Hauck's service as "House since 2021". The member page lists Dori Hauck's committee assignments as including Agriculture (Vice Chair) and the Education standing committees, and as chair of the Agriculture and Water Management Committee.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dori Hauck's occupation as Rancher.
It lists education as BS, Management/Marketing, University of Mary; MS, Business Administration, Park University, Kansas City.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Board, Richardton Healthcare Foundation.
Dori Hauck is listed as married to Doug.
